title: Dynamics 365 Sales: copy a Sales Development agent's configuration to another agent
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap details, preview copying procedure, access requirements and published consumption billing are supported. The automation note should also preserve Microsoft's warning that the reviewed beta contract does not establish deployed availability.

claims.claim: A Sales Development agent's configuration can be copied to another agent.
claims.quote: If you already have one Sales Development agent configured the way you want, you can copy that setup to a new agent instead of starting from scratch.

In the Microsoft 365 admin center, go to Agents > All Agents.

3. Choose the users or groups that can create Sales Development agent instances.
